resources.string: Changelog
Get started
Skip
Welcome to ScenePeek
A free and open-source client for TMDB & Seerr
What's new in %1$s for %2$s
TMDB
Connect your TMDB account to access your watchlist, ratings, lists and more.
Seerr
Connect to your Seerr instance to request movies and TV shows instantly.
IMDb & TMDB Link Handling
ScenePeek can open URLs from IMDb, TMDB & Letterboxd in the app. This can be useful for opening links to movies, TV shows and people directly in the app.
- Allow user to switch between grid and list view on media lists
- Add new discover filters. You can now also discover movies and tv shows by filtering with ratings and minimum votes.
- Display media favorite status on list details
- Fix an issue with discover filters between movies and tv shows
- Huge updates to ScenePeek codebase. An iOS version will soon be released!
- View posters in full screen for movies, TV shows, and people. Click any poster on a details screen to expand it to full screen!
- Add Rotten Tomatoes and Metacritic scores
- Enable login for Jellyfin/Emby users with empty passwords
- Migrate deprecated encryption library. If you were previously connected on TMDB, you'll need to re-login.
- Improve search functionality. You can now get categorized results for movies, tv shows, people, or just search through all!
- Show media release year on search and discover results
- Added a custom color theme option! Head to Settings > Appearance to give the app a more personal touch
- Add detailed error messages on jellyseerr login
- Add detailed warning when CSRF is enabled on user's jellyseerr instance
- Redesign home screen. Add sections to easily find trending, popular, upcoming and top rated movies and tv shows.
- Favorites are now categorized to movies and tv shows
- Fixed an issue where the app crashed due to invalid movie cast data
- Discover now includes year filtering. Find movies by year, decade, or year range
- Discover now includes sorting options. Sort by year, ratings, revenue, and more
- Redesigned empty state visuals for watchlist, ratings, and empty lists
- Add experimental warning and email support field on Jellyseerr login
- Introducing new season & episode details screen! You can now view information about each season and episode, and if you're logged into to TMDB, you can also rate individual episodes.
- Introduce collections screen! Show if movie belongs to a collection and lists all the movies included in that collection
- Discover now also include the keyword filter
- Show keywords on a movie or TV show information that describe its plot or mood
- Genres and keywords are now clickable, taking you to Discover with the corresponding filter applied
- Introduce streaming providers! Find where a movie or show is available for streaming, rent or purchase
- Add sort by creation date on ratings and watchlist
- Localize dates on various places in the app, to make date information more readable
- Fix an issue on discover where new filters where not applied after clearing all filters
- Fixed an issue where tabs stopped sticking and became hidden when scrolling to the bottom of the details page
- Add version checker that informs the user if a new app version is available
- Add share menu option on collections, season, episode and list details
- Add missing www subdomain on share URLs
- Fix an issue where version checker would not display if update is available
- Improve UI and compatibility for large screens, tablets and landscape mode
- Add movie release dates showing premiere, theatrical, digital and physical format information
- Add setting sections for joining the matrix community, help translating the project and more
- Only fetch new discover content when the filter settings are different from the previous search
- Fix an issue where users would not get logged in on TMDB on their first try
- Fix an issue where sorting options where not applied on discover screen
- Implement a mechanism to easily inform the users about any potential TMDB server incidents
- Add app language setting with Greek and German translations (thanks to shadow2209!)
- Add metadata language setting with many options: Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian etc. Head over to Settings > Appearance to set your preference.
- Add a descriptive label popup when selecting a rating that summarizes the rating
- Rename local favorites to collections and add TMDB favorites tab on profile
- Awards added! Browse movies, shows, and people from major ceremonies including the Oscars, Golden Globes, European Film Awards, and more. (Awards content is updated frequently!)
- Add Italian language setting
- Renamed "Collection" to "Saved" for local favorites
- Added ability to save people to local favorites
- Add Estonian & French language setting
- Add the ability to share a user's movie or show review
- Expanded movie crew credits to include authors, composers, and story writers
- Allow searching in discover filters in selected app language
- Add search history to display recent searches
- Add sorting options on lists
- Add company filter on discover
- You can now click on any company name in the details section to browse content filtered by that studio
- Added option to view Wikipedia articles in the movie and TV show 3-dot menu
- Customize home layout: reorder sections and toggle visibility
- Added Plex authentication support for Seerr
- Show recent Seerr requests in home screen
- Added support for Letterboxd URLs, allowing them to open directly in the app
- Added a view changelog option in Settings > App updates
- Added delete account option in account settings
- Fixed an issue with Seerr actions on the home screen
- Introduced show tracking functionality! You can now add shows to your list, mark individual episodes or complete seasons as watched, and monitor your viewing progress
- Added "Next Up" section in home to display your released and upcoming episodes
- Added Backup and Restore options in Settings, so you can easily save and recover your watch history
- Added age/content ratings information for movies and shows
- Added a dark-themed app icon for iOS
- Updated the action menu for movies and shows. Just tap the FAB (bottom-right) to access the new look and quickly track your favorite series
- Fixed an issue that made the app unresponsive due to an outdated library
- Added Watch History! You can now see every episode you've watched
- Added Automatic Backups that automatically saves your data every other day. Head to Settings > Backup & Restore to turn it on and never lose your progress
- Backup & Restore now also covers your saved movies, shows, and people
- Added Episode details modal in the Next Up section
- Added filters on the Upcoming, Popular, and Top Rated screens
- Added content rating filter on Discover
